subject: [PATCH v2] mm/memcontrol: fix stuck FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE bit on isolated cpus

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug where the FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE bit remains stuck on isolated CPUs, preventing future drains from retrying. The issue arises when drain_all_stock() sets the flag before checking isolation, and schedule_drain_work() drops the work in a separate RCU critical section. To fix this, the patch modifies schedule_drain_work() to return whether the work was queued, and clears FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE in drain_all_stock() when the remote CPU is isolated.
